notes: All 30 questions and all 30 gold annotations are DRAFT. A pharmacist must review each question and verify each annotation before any question can be scored. No reference answer has been fabricated: reference_answer is null on every annotation and must be filled in by a qualified reviewer.
review_workflow: Step 1: pharmacist reviews the question text and sets review_status to APPROVED (or REJECTED). Step 2: pharmacist fills reference_answer, expected_facts, forbidden_claims and sets verification_status to VERIFIED. Only then does validateDataset() accept the question as scorable.
